text: The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body must select candidates to interview for appointment as Chair of the Toronto Local Appeal Body. Following the interviews, the Nominating Panel will recommend one candidate for appointment to City Council.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment as Chair of the Toronto Local Appeal Body: Candidate LAB3-129; Candidate LAB3-139; Candidate LAB3-145; Candidate LAB3-170; Candidate LAB3-182; and Candidate LAB3-188. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (April 8, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
